tvShow.name: Sentenced to Be a Hero
tvShow.originalName: 勇者刑に処す 懲罰勇者9004隊刑務記録
tvShow.overview: In a world where heroism is a punishment, Xylo Forbartz, a condemned goddess killer, battles endless hordes of monstrous abominations as part of Penal Hero Unit 9004. Death is no escape, only a cycle of resurrection and relentless combat. But when Xylo encounters a mysterious new goddess, their unlikely alliance sparks a rebellion that could shatter the chains of eternal punishment.

episodes.name: Sentence: Support Retreat from Couveunge Forest
episodes.overview: Penal hero Xylo gets an unwelcome helper during an assignment to supporting the main army's retreat.

episodes.name: Sentence: Spearhead the Recapture of the Zewan Gan Tunnels 1
episodes.overview: A convicted goddess killer is condemned to a cycle of eternal punishment of battling hordes of enemies.

episodes.name: Sentence: Spearhead the Recapture of the Zewan Gan Tunnels 2
episodes.overview: Xylo's party embarks on a suicide mission to save a group of miners trapped in the tunnels.

episodes.name: Standby Order: Mureed Fortress
episodes.overview: The heroes' time off at a city festival is actually a prelude to a coming terror.

episodes.name: Sentence: Defense Against Corruption at Mureed Fortress 1
episodes.overview: A motley crew assembles for the defense of Mureed Fortress.

episodes.name: Sentence: Defense Against Corruption at Mureed Fortress 2
episodes.overview: As hope seems to slip away, Teoritta and Xylo make a do-or-die gambit against Demon Lord Iblis.

episodes.name: Sentence: Feigned Day Off at Port City Ioff
episodes.overview: What appears to be the heroes' first true day off turns into a job protecting Teoritta from assassins.

episodes.name: Sentence: Undercover Investigation in District of Sodrick 1
episodes.overview: To investigate the would-be assassins, an unexpected duo goes undercover in the Adventurers Guild.

episodes.name: Sentence: Undercover Investigation in District of Sodrick 2
episodes.overview: The chaos in Sodrick's Shell continues to spiral as Lideo Sodrick's fate hangs in the balance.

episodes.name: Sentence: Aid In Evacuation of Ioff Cheg Port 1
episodes.overview: A new comrade joins the heroes' forces as they take on a faerie invasion in the heart of the city.

episodes.name: Sentence: Aid In Evacuation of Ioff Cheg Port 2
episodes.overview: Xylo and Teoritta make a charge for Tua Jia tower while Kivia pursues a mystery of her own.

episodes.name: Sentence: Aid In Evacuation of Ioff Cheg Port 3
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the battle, revelations are made, and Kivia faces a haunting decision.
